newsitem.title: USA: GM says 21,488 employees still idled.
newsitem.headline: GM says 21,488 employees still idled.

text.p: General Motors Corp said Monday that there were 21,488 GM North American employees still idled as of 1100 EST as a result of a strike by the Canadian Auto Workers Union that ended last week.
The number does not include its Delphi operations where a majority of employees have returned to work. As of today, Delphi will no longer issue daily reports.
Buick City in Flint, Mich. was idled affecting 3,200 employees, and a Detroit/Hamtramck assembly facility brought back 1,100 for first shift operations only, GM said in a statement.
"We will not speculate on when workers in the U.S. will return to their operations. In addition, we will not speculate on additional facilities that could be affected," according to the GM statement.
Another update will be issued at 1600 EST Monday, GM said.
CAW members ratified a tentative labor agreement last Tuesday and are returning to work in stages.
